draft_en.subject: For your ATMS roadside cabinets - the 8-port managed PoE DIN unit, with specs
draft_en.body:
Hi Chirag,

You told us in 2024 that your roadside cabinets only need 4- and 8-port industrial switches with L2 / web management - nothing bigger. (You also had our general product mails since; no need to answer those.)

The 8-port unit for those cabinets: DIN-rail 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP, L2 managed (web GUI, VLAN, QoS, IGMP), Marvell-based, -40 to 75 C, CE/RoHS (BIS stays on your side) - model STI-288GPM - $82.2 USD EXW (MOQ 1, 15-day validity); the 4-PoE + 1 RJ45 + 1 SFP unmanaged unit for small cabinets - STI-154GP - $39.2.

One question: shall I send the surge-protection and temperature specs in the format your ATMS tenders ask for - and is Chirag or Manan the right person for that file?

Best regards,
Simon
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
